Iron ore enters 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; 10-year US Treasury yield at 4.94% amplifies global risk-off
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate-cut timeline
ANZ.AX axes 3,500 jobs in restructuring; execution risk remains elevated
Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c as oil suppression fails; Santos.AX, WDS.AX in focus
Housing prices crash with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auction market
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals sector stress; small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) outperform
Superannuation reform debate intensifies; populism vs. structural integrity tension

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; cap-raise dash signals cash-flow stress. Small-cap explorers (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Kuniko, Gateway WA) see relative outperformance as large-caps sell off.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) may benefit from safe-haven flows. Battery tech (CRB.AX) holds firm, offering diversification.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising yields and rate fears pressure valuations. ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 jobs cut) signals cost discipline but execution risk. RBA rental inflation concern delays rate-cut expectations.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure if RBA holds. Rising bond yields (4.94% US 10Y) compress equity multiples. Superannuation debate adds policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Mixed-positive. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; fuel prices +30c. Australia softens gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic sacrifice.
sectors.implications: SANT.AX, WDS.AX, AGL.AX benefit from oil/gas price strength. Higher fuel costs hit consumer margins (WES.AX, WOW.AX). Gas supply flexibility supports LNG exporters.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths (WOW.AX) price-freeze credibility questioned. Australian businesses 'fear for their future.' Housing correction pressures construction-linked demand.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin squeeze from input costs. Defensive rotation into staples likely. Housing crash (60) may boost first-home buyer products but dampens broader consumer spending.

sectors.trend: Selective positive. ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. AI security and battery tech themes resilient. Global AI capex (Dell, Alibaba, Netskope) supports sentiment.
sectors.implications: Small-cap ASX names show relative strength. Battery/energy storage (CRB.AX) and AI-adjacent names offer thematic exposure. Cap-raise risk in mining small-caps warrants caution.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing prices crash; no auction spring bounce. NZ five-year correction still running. Property chiefs call for more migrants to address supply gap.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Residential REITs hit hardest. Commercial REITs may stabilise if rate cuts eventually materialise.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / commodity downturn
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX) and battery tech (CRB.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy uncertainty / delayed rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via bond ladders; favour floating-rate REITs; monitor RBA statements for rental inflation guidance
Overweight exporters (BHP, WDS); underweight import-dependent consumer (WOW, WES); consider AUD-hedged positions
Underweight residential REITs; monitor bank NPL trends; favour commercial and infrastructure REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining cap-raise dilution and liquidity stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid small-cap miners with imminent cap raises; favour cash-flow-positive producers
Monitor legislative changes; favour diversified super fund managers; avoid single-theme exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and battery-tech names as commodity diversifiers
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and AUD weakness support gold; battery tech (CRB.AX) holds firm in month-long test

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil price surge
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; gas supply rule softening supports LNG exporters; fuel price pass-through benefits producers
PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka, Iondrive, Neurizon showing relative strength; AI and critical-mines themes resilient

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore and bank exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX $90bn wipeout driven by miners/banks; iron ore bloodletting and rate fears create downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight residential REITs and consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing crash, no auction bounce, and Woolworths price-freeze breach signal consumer and property stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and rate risk via bond ladders
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; US 10Y at 4.94% signals global tightening; RBA rental inflation concern delays cuts

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as iron ore weakness, rising yields, and AUD depreciation persist. RBA rental inflation commentary may delay rate-cut expectations. Oil-driven fuel cost increases pressure consumer margins. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US Treasury yield moves.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points for quality REITs and banks once stabilised. Energy transition (battery tech, gas flexibility) offers structural growth. Superannuation reform, if constructive, could boost long-term fund flows. Iron ore oversupply risk remains the key overhang for materials.
